stories.title: datasette-cluster-map 0.19
stories.author: Simon Willison
stories.snippet: Release: datasette-cluster-map 0.19 One of the oldest Datasette plugins, and still one of my favorites. It now works with Datasette 1.0a42, and depends on the new datasette-leaflet to ensure OpenStreetMap tiles are requested with a referrer header. Here's a map of power plants owned by California's PG&E , also demonstrating Datasette's recently redesigned facets : Tags: datasette , geospatial , openstreetmap

stories.title: datasette-leaflet 0.3
stories.author: Simon Willison
stories.snippet: Release: datasette-leaflet 0.3 OpenStreetMap have a very reasonable policy that hits to their hosted tile server should send a referrer header . Datasette table pages used the Referrer-Policy: no-referrer HTTP header, causing plugins that loaded tiles from OpenStreetMap to violate that policy. datasette-leaflet is the plugin that loads a bundled Leaflet so other Datasette plugins can depend on it. It now sets the referrer policy on the tile requests themselves to strict-origin-when-cross-origin , passing the host but not the full path to the page. Tags: leaflet , datasette , openstreetmap
